title: Pure Super Defence Robot
summary: Orbital 7's Super Defence Robot ('Super Defense Robot' in the TCG) archetype is an EARTH Machine Rank 4 and Rank 8 Xyz swarm deck consisting of Super Defense Robot Lio (Level 4), Super Defense Robot Monki (Level 3), Super Defense Robot Elephan (Level 8), Orbital 7 (Level 4), and their signature Rank 8 boss Googly-Eyes Drum Dragon! Every Super Defense Robot monster Special Summons another 'Super Defense Robot' monster or 'Orbital 7' from your hand when Normal Summoned! Normal Summon Super Defense Robot Lio to Special Summon Monki from your hand, then banish a Machine from your GY with Monki to add Elephan or Orbital 7 from your GY to your hand—which immediately triggers Lio's second effect ('When exactly 1 "Super Defense Robot" monster or "Orbital 7" is added from your GY to your hand: You can Special Summon it from your hand')! Finally, use Elephan on the field to make a Super Defense Robot or Orbital 7 become Level 8 so you can overlay two Level 8s into the 4000 ATK Googly-Eyes Drum Dragon or Dingirsu!

allow.Scrap Recycler: Level 3 EARTH Machine starter: sends 'Super Defense Robot Elephan' or 'Orbital 7' directly from your Deck to the GY on Normal or Special Summon—putting both into your GY so Super Defense Robot Monki can banish Scrap Recycler to add Elephan to your hand and immediately trigger Super Defense Robot Lio to Special Summon Elephan!
allow.Machina Gearframe: Level 4 EARTH Machine Union monster that searches Machina Fortress on Normal Summon and pairs with Level 4 Super Defense Robot Lio or Orbital 7 for Rank 4 Gear Gigant X.
allow.Machina Fortress: Level 7 EARTH Machine (2500 ATK) that discards Level 8 'Super Defense Robot Elephan' + another Machine from your hand to Special Summon itself—putting Elephan into your GY for Monki + Lio to recover and Special Summon!
allow.Machine Duplication: Normal Spell that targets 'Orbital 7' (a LIGHT Machine monster with exactly 500 base ATK!) to Special Summon up to 2 additional copies of 'Orbital 7' directly from your Deck!
allow.Clockwork Night: Continuous Spell searched by Clockwork Knight that boosts all your Super Defense Robots by 500 ATK, weakens opponent's monsters by 500 ATK, and banishes from GY to search Level 8 EARTH Machine Super Defense Robot Elephan!
allow.Foolish Burial: Limited to 1 in TCG: sends 'Super Defense Robot Elephan' or 'Orbital 7' directly from your Deck to the GY so Monki + Lio can recover and Special Summon it!
allow.Gear Gigant X: Rank 4 EARTH Machine Xyz (2 Level 4 Machine monsters: Super Defense Robot Lio, Orbital 7, or Machina Gearframe!) that detaches 1 material to add Super Defense Robot Lio, Monki, Orbital 7, or Scrap Recycler from your Deck or GY to your hand!
allow.Dingirsu, the Orcust of the Evening Star: Rank 8 Machine Xyz (2 Level 8 monsters: Super Defense Robot Elephan + any Robot turned Level 8 by Elephan's effect!) that sends an opponent's card to the GY without targeting and protects your Machines from destruction.
allow.Number 38: Hope Harbinger Dragon Titanic: Rank 8 Xyz (2 Level 8 monsters) summoned via Elephan's Level-8 modulation effect that negates Spells.
allow.Platinum Gadget: Link-2 LIGHT Machine that Special Summons Super Defense Robot Lio, Monki, or Orbital 7 from your hand.
allow.Clockwork Knight: Link-1 EARTH Machine summoned using Scrap Recycler or Monki that searches Clockwork Night and revives an EARTH Machine from your GY.
allow.Ancient Gear Ballista: Link-2 EARTH Machine made with two EARTH Machines that pops a Spell/Trap to reduce an opponent's monster's ATK/DEF to 0.

main: Super Defense Robot Lio

Core Level 4 EARTH Machine (1200 ATK / 1600 DEF): when Normal Summoned, Special Summons 1 'Super Defense Robot' monster or 'Orbital 7' from your hand; AND once per turn, when exactly 1 'Super Defense Robot' monster or 'Orbital 7' is added from your GY to your hand (such as by Monki, Orbital 7, or Gear Gigant X!), immediately Special Summons that monster from your hand!
Super Defense Robot Monki

Core Level 3 EARTH Machine (800 ATK / 1200 DEF): when Normal Summoned, Special Summons 1 'Super Defense Robot' monster or 'Orbital 7' from your hand; once per turn banishes 1 Machine monster from your GY to target 1 'Super Defense Robot' monster or 'Orbital 7' in your GY and add it to your hand (which immediately triggers Lio to Special Summon it to the field!)!
Super Defense Robot Elephan

Core Level 8 EARTH Machine (1400 ATK / 2500 DEF): when Normal Summoned, Special Summons 1 'Super Defense Robot' monster or 'Orbital 7' from your hand; once per turn targets 1 'Super Defense Robot' monster or 'Orbital 7' you control and makes it become Level 8 until the End Phase—allowing Elephan + any Robot to Xyz Summon Rank 8 Googly-Eyes Drum Dragon or Dingirsu!
Orbital 7

Signature Level 4 LIGHT Machine companion (500 ATK / 2000 DEF): gains 1 You Got It Boss! Counter when flipped face-up and removes counters to become 2000 ATK; tributes itself to target 1 'Photon' or 'Galaxy' monster in your GY or pairs with every Super Defense Robot effect by name; and has 500 ATK to unlock Machine Duplication!
Scrap Recycler

Normal Summon starter that sends Super Defense Robot Elephan or Orbital 7 from your Deck to the GY, then links into Clockwork Knight (putting Scrap Recycler in the GY as the Machine banish cost for Monki!).
Machina Gearframe
Searches Machina Fortress on Normal Summon and pairs with Level 4 Lio or Orbital 7 to Xyz Summon Rank 4 Gear Gigant X.
Machina Fortress

Discards Level 8 Super Defense Robot Elephan from your hand (loading Elephan into the GY so Monki can recover it and Lio can Special Summon it without Tributing!) to Special Summon itself from hand or GY.
Machine Duplication
Targets face-up 'Orbital 7' (500 ATK Machine) to Special Summon 2 more copies of Orbital 7 directly from your Deck for instant Rank 4 Gear Gigant X and Link-2 Platinum Gadget plays!
Clockwork Night
Searched by Clockwork Knight: boosts all your Machine Robots by 500 ATK, drops opponent's monsters by 500 ATK, and banishes from GY to search Super Defense Robot Elephan, Lio, or Monki!
Foolish Burial
Limited to 1 in TCG: sends Super Defense Robot Elephan from your Deck to the GY so Monki + Lio can recover and Special Summon it immediately.
extra: Orbital 7's signature Rank 8 EARTH Machine Xyz boss (2 Level 8 Machine monsters: Super Defense Robot Elephan + any Robot turned Level 8 by Elephan's effect!; 3000 ATK): once per turn detaches 1 material to gain 1000 ATK (reaching 4000 ATK!) until the end of your opponent's next turn; and if destroyed while it has Xyz Material, you can banish 1 'Super Defense Robot' monster from your GY to immediately revive Googly-Eyes Drum Dragon!

Rank 4 EARTH Machine Xyz (2 Level 4 Machine monsters: Lio, Orbital 7, or Gearframe): detaches 1 material to add ANY Level 4 or lower Machine from your Deck or GY to your hand—and if you use Gear Gigant X to add a Super Defense Robot or Orbital 7 from your GY to your hand while Lio is on the field, Lio immediately Special Summons it!
Dingirsu, the Orcust of the Evening Star
Rank 8 Machine Xyz (summoned using Elephan + a Level-8 modulated Super Defense Robot) that sends an opponent's card to the GY without targeting and detaches 1 material to protect your board.
Number 38: Hope Harbinger Dragon Titanic Galaxy
Rank 8 Xyz summoned via Elephan's Level-8 modulation to negate opposing Spells.
Link-2 Machine that Special Summons Super Defense Robot Lio, Monki, or Orbital 7 from your hand.
Link-1 EARTH Machine that searches Clockwork Night and revives an EARTH Machine from your GY.
Link-2 EARTH Machine made with two EARTH Machines that pops a Spell/Trap to reduce an opponent's monster's ATK/DEF to 0.
